source_title: Stephen Graham Credits Wife Hannah for Helping Him Get into the Mind of a Serial Killer in Nocturne (Exclusive) - People.com
source_excerpt:
The actor reveals how his wife’s fascination with true crime helped him prepare to portray a serial killer in his new Apple TV series
Stephen Graham told PEOPLE how his wife Hannah Walters helped him while preparing for his sinister role in Nocturne at the series premiere on Oct. 20
“She is an absolute fanatic for serial killers and true life crime documentaries,” he said
Stephen Graham is crediting his wife for helping him step into the mind of a serial killer for his new series, Nocturne .
Speaking exclusively to PEOPLE at the Apple TV crime thriller’s premiere in New York on Oct. 20, the English actor, 53, said his wife Hannah Walters , 52, is to thank for his chilling performance.
“I’m gonna give the credit to my wife,” he told PEOPLE. “She is an absolute fanatic for serial killers and true life crime documentaries.”
He and Walters have been married since 2008, and have two children : Grace Graham, 21, and Alfie Graham, 19.
“So she made me watch loads,” he added of his preparation. “I watched about 45 of them. She kept saying, ‘You need to see this one, this one, this one, and this one.’ So I think then subconsciously it goes into your mind and then you try and get into that mindset to the best of your ability, do you know what I mean?”
The couple have collaborated on over a dozen projects, and founded their own production company, Matriarch Productions, in 2020. They also produced Netflix’s Adolescence and Disney+’s A Thousand Blows .
Graham also told PEOPLE that his trainer, professional bodybuilder Rob Thurston, helped him get ready for Nocturne physically.
“I wanted to get into a physical shape where it looked like I could kill you with my bare hands if I wanted to. So we worked really hard on that,” he said.
Additionally, Graham said that in his opinion, Nocturne ’s director, Tim Van Patten, “is one of the best that ever is.”
“And then you’re working with a wonderful cast. So you have trust on set. And John Lavin, an amazing showrunner. You know, we worked a lot on the character and on the dialogue and, and then you just get onto set and you play,” he told PEOPLE.
In Nocturne , Graham stars as the diabolically cunning serial killer Jurek Walter.
The series is set in a small town in western Pennsylvania, and follows Jonah Lynn ( Liev Schreiber ), an ex-soldier turned homicide detective who recently moved to the idyllic area after becoming tired of working the tough streets of Philadelphia.

Things change when the town and his family come under attack from Jurek, and Jonah must protect all that he holds dear, according to an official synopsis . “When the desperate search for Jurek’s last missing victim forces Jonah to send his surrogate daughter, FBI Agent Saga Bauer ( Zazie Beetz ), up against Jurek, how far will Jonah go?”
Nocturne premiered on Friday, Oct. 30, and episodes are available to stream on Apple TV .
